name: play_move
description: Play one move as a point like Q16, or `pass`. The opponent then replies through the game harness. Returns the opponent's reply, the board and the state of the game.

name: game_status
description: Return the current board, the move list, the state of the game and the resets remaining.

name: reset_game
description: Abandon the current game and start again from the starting position. 6 resets in total.

name: write_notes
description: Replace your plain-text notepad notes.txt with a checkpoint.

name: read_notes
description: Read your notepad and the time and resets remaining.

name: api_request
description: Request an episode service using its URL, HTTP method, and JSON-encoded headers and body. Returns a JSON response.

name: list_files
description: List immediate children of an absolute episode directory. No recursion or file previews.

name: read_file
description: Read UTF-8 text at an absolute episode path using byte offset and limit (1–16384). Does not follow or expand referenced files.

name: write_file
description: Replace one writable episode file with plain text. No code is executed by this file tool.
